source.note: The GREEN artifact ⊆ artifact cover witness on the ARGUMENT (cost) axis — corroborates policy:argument:subject-cover (Chatterfang, creature axis) generalized to artifacts. Ruthless Knave emits a Treasure (a colorless Treasure artifact token) via 'Create two Treasure tokens'; Krark-Clan Ironworks is an artifact-sacrifice OUTLET whose activation cost is 'Sacrifice an artifact' (an argument/cost-consume demanding an artifact object). The Treasure (type Artifact, subtype Treasure) provably COVERS the 'artifact' cost parameter — treasure ⊆ artifact, no straddle → GREEN. NOT a loop: Ruthless Knave needs {2}{B} to make Treasures but Krark-Clan Ironworks yields only {C}{C} colorless — the black pip is unrefillable, so the Treasure→sac→mana path is a ramp/value interaction, not a repeating cycle (unit=pairwise, no §10 SDF balance). Live ADR-2 shadow: Ruthless Knave emits emit:token:artifact:treasure:controlled (stem shadow=deployment:creature) and Krark-Clan Ironworks consumes sac:artifact:controlled (stem shadow=creature, manner=sacrificed) — the shadow stem-maps ALL sacrifice fodder to creature, the Stage-3 engine-catch-up gap; but the LABELS prove the parser derives artifact-type + controlled scope + treasure subtype from the AST, so the ADR-3 stems (deployment:artifact / artifact) are faithfully AST-derivable, not a wish. No edhrec_rank / real combo popularity for this pair in the testbed — popularity omitted (not fabricated).

judge.ref: ij 2026-07-17 b7 — artifact cover GREEN (treasure subset artifact); redundant sibling collapsed; edge is structural subsumption; PROCEED

Ruthless Knave.note: THE FODDER SOURCE — 'Create two Treasure tokens' (line 0, spans [29,138]); a Treasure is a colorless Treasure ARTIFACT token, so this deploys an artifact object under your control. Reuses the witnessed R4 shape from ruthless-knave-x-blood-artist. Live ADR-2 label: emit:token:artifact:treasure:controlled (stem shadow=deployment:creature; the token→artifact stem-map is the shadow-projection gap, but the label carries artifact:treasure:controlled).

Krark-Clan Ironworks.note: THE WITNESS — 'Sacrifice an artifact:' (line 0, spans [0,22]); the activation-cost argument-consume, an artifact OBJECT demanded as a cost (the objects-supergroup fodder decrement, a bare object-consume). control=you: sacrificing a permanent means one you control (CR 701.21a — 'its controller moves it'). No exclude_self: 'an artifact' includes Krark-Clan Ironworks itself, unlike Ruthless Knave's 'another creature'. Live ADR-2 label: sac:artifact:controlled (stem shadow=creature, manner=sacrificed — the shadow maps all sac fodder to stem=creature; the label proves the parser derives the artifact type + controlled scope).

incidental card context — 'Add {C}{C}.' (line 0, spans [22,34]); the payoff the sacrifice pays for, which makes Krark-Clan Ironworks a repeatable OUTLET. Not the witness; the KCI1→KCI2 (cost pays for mana) binding is card-defined/internal, not an inter-card edge. Live ADR-2 label: emit:mana:colorless.

notes: Ruthless Knave's deployed Treasure (type Artifact, subtype Treasure) satisfies Krark-Clan Ironworks' 'Sacrifice an artifact' cost. The supplied object's at-creation type (artifact:treasure) provably COVERS the 'artifact' parameter filter — treasure ⊆ artifact by the type-ontology subtype lattice (CR 205.3, a Treasure IS an artifact), no subtype straddle; and control=you ⊆ you. Subsumption is structural/self-certifying → GREEN. The artifact-axis analogue of Ruthless Knave→Blood Artist's creature ⊆ creature GREEN, but on the ARGUMENT/cost side (a cost demanding an artifact) rather than the subscription/trigger side.

assertions.because: the supplied Treasure's type (artifact:treasure) provably covers the 'artifact' cost parameter — treasure ⊆ artifact (subtype lattice, CR 205.3), no straddle; control=you ⊆ you. Subsumption is structural.

policy:argument:subject-cover-artifact carries corroborates:policy:argument:subject-cover — the argument subject-cover match generalizes from the creature axis (Chatterfang) to the artifact axis; a reference/corroboration, NOT a re-declaration of the parent rule.

the artifact-scoped cost ('an artifact') is covered by an artifact-typed fodder — treasure ⊆ artifact; the artifact-axis witness of the type-cover policy, complementing the creature ⊆ creature cover (ruthless-knave-x-blood-artist).

A one-shot ramp/value interaction, not a repeating cycle (no §10 SDF balance). The KCI1→KCI2 cost→mana binding is card-defined, not an inter-card edge.
